transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Ever since my father-in-law moved in, I’ve just been on edge. I snap at my wife over little things around the house, and I’ve been putting off jobs and paperwork I normally handle. Even when I’m out in the workshop or trying to fish, I can’t seem to quiet my mind down.
Did these feelings start after your father-in-law moved in?
Yeah. He moved in after his fall, and within the first couple of months I was already getting behind on paperwork and arguing with my wife about all the changes around the house.
Since this started, have you been feeling down or depressed most days?
I’m not really sure. I’ve mostly noticed being tense and irritated, more than feeling down.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about many different parts of your life, not just the situation with your father-in-law?
I don’t know that I’m worrying about everything. It’s mostly the situation at home that keeps running through my head.
Have you been feeling sad much of the time since this started?
I wouldn’t say sad much of the time. It’s more that I feel on edge and frustrated with everything going on at home.
Have these feelings been interfering with how you function day to day?

Yeah, it has. I missed an important deadline for my contractor license filing, and I’ve had to put off or turn down some small repair jobs because I’m not keeping up like I used to. At home, it’s caused real tension with my wife, and I’m having a harder time following through on family responsibilities.
Since this started, have you been losing interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a big change in that, exactly.
Since this started, have you been feeling hopeless?
I’m not sure I’d call it hopeless. I’m mostly just stressed and frustrated by the situation.
Since this started, have you been feeling down much of the time?
I don’t know if I’ve been down most of the time. I’ve mainly been stressed and irritated about everything.
Since this started, have you been feeling depressed?
I wouldn’t say depressed, really. I’ve been more stressed and irritated than anything else.
Since this started, have you been crying more than usual?
I haven’t really noticed myself crying more than usual.
Since this started, have you been feeling discouraged?
I’m not really sure I’d call it discouraged. It’s more that I’ve been stressed and irritated.
Since this started, have you been feeling guilty?
I don’t think guilt has really been a part of it, no.
Since this started, have you felt sad or low, even some of the time?
I’m not sure. I’ve mostly just noticed the stress and irritation, not really feeling sad or low.
Since this started, have you felt sad or down at all?
No, I haven’t really felt sad or down. It’s been more stress than anything else.
